label: XDCR conflict resolution method
type: the bucket-level, fixed-at-creation choice determining which side wins when XDCR detects a write conflict: Sequence Number (the default) or Timestamp. Named inconsistently across this project's own two server-side reference pages - see docs-issues.
recurrence_note: First minted from a Capella page (round 7); this round's server pages are the second and third independent attestations.
evidence: XDCR provides two types of conflict resolution, based on either sequence number or timestamp, whereby conflicted data can be saved consistently on source and target.
The default conflict resolution setting is based on sequence number.
note: NAMED INCONSISTENTLY WITHIN THIS ROUND'S OWN BATCH: xdcr-filtering-reference-intro.md calls the two values 'revision-based'/'timestamp-based'; xdcr-advanced-settings.md calls the identical choice 'sequence number'/'timestamp'. Both resolve to this one concept; the docs themselves do not agree on what to call the non-timestamp option. See docs-issues/server-xdcr-conflict-resolution-method-named-inconsistently.
relates_to_competency_question: When XDCR replication produces a write conflict, which of two possible rules decides the winner, and is that choice named consistently across the docs?
